newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys firm.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys firm.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed in mostly light volume, with nearby December gaining on shortcovering, traders said.
"There's still a couple of commercials who are short the (December contract) and who want to come out," a trader said.

MGE spring wheat stayed firm compared to CBOT wheat, which closed lower after delivery notices of 1.15 million bushels were posted Wednesday against the December contract. No deliveries were posted Wednesday on MGE wheat.
MGE spring wheat closed three cents lower to 4-1/4 cents higher, with December up 4-1/4 cents at $4.17-1/2 a bushel. March gained 1/4 cent to close at $3.73-1/4.

Traders said Atwood/Peavey bought one million March and sold 500,000 March bushels. Frontier, Benson-Quinn, LFG and Wilson each bought at least 500,000 March. Wilson bear-spread 1.2 million May/March bushels at 11-1/2 to 13 cents.
MGE barley futures closed five cents per cwt lower to eight cents higher, with March up eight at $6.50.
